company.story: KITE began in 2022 with two Kiters and a simple ambition: to create work worth flying for. What started as a small creative team grew into a squad of 15, brought together by a shared love for ideas, design, storytelling and the challenge of making brands stand out.
company.positioning: KITE creates visual communication for brands — across branding, media, digital content, marketing materials and web development.
company.vision: A sky full of kites. A creative environment where every brand can have its own distinct shape, color and direction.
company.mission: We create visual communication that looks distinctive, communicates clearly, and gives brands a voice people can remember.
philosophy: Products, services and organizations change — their brands need to evolve with them.
Branding should create strategic and coherent conversations between brands and their audiences.
Creativity should connect business strategy with memorable visual execution.
company.how_we_work: We don't fit projects into predetermined processes. We create bespoke teams around each project.
